MASTER YOUR GAME

LEARN TO PLAY

TOUCH CONTROLS / PLAYER
Drag the left stick to move and aim. Tap PASS or THROUGH to pass, CROSS to loft the ball. Hold SHOOT, then release to strike. Without the ball, PASS tackles and SHOOT slides. Tap SPRINT to toggle running. Hold PRESS or SKILL / JOCKEY; tap SWITCH to change player. MORE opens camera and tactics.

REFEREE SIMULATOR
Move with the stick. Drag a clear part of the pitch to look around 360°. The LOOK LEFT / RIGHT buttons also turn the camera, or tap FACE BALL to find the action. SPRINT toggles running. WHISTLE signals to the players. When an incident appears, choose a decision or CHECK VAR on its panel. The casebook records your calls.

REVIEW & TEAM MANAGEMENT
VAR: tap camera angles, drag the timeline, change speed, pause playback, hide/show the panel, then return to decide. Before kickoff, open FORMATION & STARTING XI to choose starters freely. During a player match, Pause → Formation & substitutions: drag a reserve onto a starter, or tap two player cards. Referee mode permits squad inspection only. Drag two starters to swap their positions.

LANDSCAPE
Play with your phone sideways. The top-right buttons pause the game or request fullscreen. Rotating to portrait pauses play. Resume after turning sideways again.

Click a key, then press its replacement. Two slots are available per action. Escape cancels capture and always remains available to exit.

Default controls are ready to play.

Playing: Hold Shoot to build power, release to strike. Aim while moving and pass toward teammates. The intended receiver automatically approaches the incoming ball for ground passes, through balls and crosses. Sprinting drains stamina. Your nearest defender is selected automatically when the opposition has possession.
Goalkeepers: A ball caught in the keeper's hands is protected until distribution. Goalkeepers normally guard the goal line, collect nearby safe loose balls and release catches automatically.
REFEREE SIMULATOR: Move relative to your camera, turn your view or face the ball. Assess incidents using the configured decisions above. The penalty option appears only for a foul inside the defending area; chosen decisions still apply when incorrect. VAR offers three angles, playback speed, a contact frame and a hide/show panel control. The casebook records judgments and positioning. Contact and offside checks are simplified for this game.

MAKE IT YOUR MATCH

MATCH SETTINGS

Picture & play



CPU tuning

Stadium sound

Original synthesized stereo crowd, referee whistles, ball impacts, goal reactions and an instrumental menu loop. Audio starts after your first interaction.

CPU difficulty changes decision speed, positioning pressure and execution error. Players use equal physical speed rules on both teams.

WebGL provides full 3D. A software perspective view is used when WebGL is unavailable. Auto quality reduces render resolution if frames stay slow. For older laptops, choose Low and close other heavy tabs. Settings are saved on this browser when storage is available.
